@graph.description: Brant Business Interiors is an OECM-approved vendor of record for office furniture. Ontario school boards, hospitals, municipalities, colleges, and not-for-profits can purchase under existing OECM agreements without running a separate RFP.

mainEntity.name: Who is eligible to buy from Brant Business Interiors under OECM Agreement 2025-470?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any OECM-eligible Ontario organization: school boards (K-12), publicly-assisted colleges and universities, hospitals and CCACs, municipalities and their agencies, broader-public-sector organizations, and not-for-profits in social services and education. OECM publishes the full eligible-buyer list on their site. Not sure if your organization qualifies? Call 1-800-835-9565 and we'll confirm in five minutes.

mainEntity.name: Do I still need to run an RFP under Agreement 2025-470?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. OECM has already run the procurement on your behalf — pricing, warranty terms, delivery windows, and product compliance are all pre-negotiated at the master-agreement level. Your organization's purchasing policy still applies (signing limits, board approvals, internal PO authorization), but the 6–8 weeks normally spent issuing an RFP, evaluating bids, and writing a contract is what disappears.

mainEntity.name: Which categories and brands are covered under Agreement 2025-470?

acceptedAnswer.text: The full Brant Business Interiors furniture catalog — seating, desks and workstations, tables, storage and filing, panels and dividers, and accessories. See the coverage table on this page for storefront-callable brand × category counts. 25+ additional Agreement-eligible manufacturer lines (Lacasse, Safco, ergoCentric, Keilhauer, and others) are quoted on request.

mainEntity.name: How fast is the quote turnaround?

acceptedAnswer.text: One business day on most line-item quotes. Larger projects with a free design-layout component typically take 5 business days. You'll be talking to the same Ontario account team that owns your file through install and warranty — not an offshore quote desk.

mainEntity.name: Is the OECM price always the lowest available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Honestly, not always — an open-tender bid on a single very-high-volume SKU can occasionally beat the OECM rate. But once you factor in tender cost, evaluation time, and the risk of a non-compliant low bidder, OECM nets out cheaper on the vast majority of orders. For very large fit-outs we'll tell you directly if running a separate tender would save you money.

mainEntity.name: How do delivery and installation work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our own crew handles delivery, assembly, levelling, and removal of old furniture — we don't subcontract logistics. After-hours and weekend installs are available for occupied spaces, which matters for schools and hospitals. W5-cleared installers for ministry and hospital sites.

mainEntity.name: What's the warranty handling under OECM?

acceptedAnswer.text: Same as any Brant Business Interiors order — we file the manufacturer claim on your behalf and keep the piece in service. Multi-year warranties across Global, OTG, Heartwood, ergoCentric, and the rest of our authorized lines; specific terms vary by manufacturer. Loaner chairs available during repair. One service contact, Ontario-based.

mainEntity.name: Can I add non-OECM-eligible items to the same PO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We can split a single quote into the Agreement 2025-470-eligible portion (drawn against the master agreement) and any out-of-scope items handled under your normal procurement. You get one delivery, one install, one invoice — procurement tracking lists the two streams.
